item.title: How much do immigrants pay in taxes?
item.description: Foreign-born New Yorkers contribute significantly to the state's economy, paying billions in taxes and fees, and the New York for All Act seeks to protect these contributions by preventing state and local agencies from cooperating with federal immigration enforcement.
